runners_data.name: Distant Rumble

runners_data.name: Strike
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up performer with solid recent form but 7lb apprentice claim may hinder tactical positioning at crucial moments.

runners_data.name: Arabian Cobra
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with visor fitted, ideal to exploit lack of pace pressure but carries top weight burden.

runners_data.name: Mumayaz
runners_data.note: Sharp hold-up horse arriving off career-best win just 5 days ago, Tony Carroll firing at 15% strike-rate lately.

runners_data.name: Forever My Prince
runners_data.note: Prominent racer stepping back to 6f with 3lb apprentice claim, well-positioned to track the leader throughout.

runners_data.name: Ararat
runners_data.note: Prominent type returning from 68-day break for struggling yard, needs career-best effort to feature prominently.

runners_data.name: Optimatum
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning from lengthy 174-day absence, distance drop may not suit patient running style.

runners_data.name: Safari Dream
runners_data.note: Reliable prominent performer for in-form Rod Millman yard, consistent 6f specialist with tactical speed.

runners_data.name: Land Of Magic
runners_data.note: Front-rank performer fitted with hood and tongue-tie, quick return from 10 days ago raises fitness questions.

races.paceDynamic: Arabian Cobra will be the sole pace-setter from the rail, with Forever My Prince, Safari Dream, Ararat and Land Of Magic settling prominently behind. The strong hold-up contingent of Strike, Mumayaz, Distant Rumble and Optimatum will track from mid-division and beyond. With only one confirmed leader, Arabian Cobra can dictate fractions without early pressure, creating a controlled tempo that builds gradually. This sustainable pace scenario clearly favours the prominent racers who can track the leader without cover concerns, giving them first strike on the turn for home before the hold-up horses can mount their challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Tempo Favours Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Arabian Cobra leads uncontested and sets manageable fractions through halfway
scenarios.body: The prominent quartet get perfect positioning behind the leader without having to use energy, allowing them to kick first approaching the final furlong. Hold-up horses find the pace too honest late and struggle to make up ground on the compact 6f trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Hold-Up
scenarios.trigger: If Arabian Cobra goes too slow early and the field bunches up approaching the turn
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a sprint finish where the most talented hold-up horses can unleash their turn of foot. Strike and Mumayaz benefit most from their patient tactics when genuine speed horses get caught flat-footed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Arabian Cobra Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If the leader maintains a steady gallop and the prominent horses fail to quicken decisively
scenarios.body: Arabian Cobra's uncontested lead gives him enough cushion to hold off late challenges, particularly with the step back to 6f suiting his front-running style. The hold-up brigade leave their runs too late on the sharp Salisbury track.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Forever My Prince or Safari Dream challenge Arabian Cobra earlier than expected
scenarios.body: An unexpected pace battle softens up the early leaders, creating opportunities for the patient hold-up horses to sweep past tired front-runners. Mumayaz's recent winning form becomes crucial in a tactical finish.

watchPoints.text: Arabian Cobra's early fractions will determine the entire race complexion - if he goes too fast early, prominent horses suffer
Forever My Prince and Safari Dream's positioning behind Arabian Cobra - if either challenges prematurely, it ruins prominent tactics
Strike's apprentice jockey getting the right tactical split in the final furlong when rapid decisions matter most
Mumayaz's quick 5-day turnaround showing any signs of fatigue in the preliminaries after his recent winning effort
Optimatum's ring sharpness after 174-day layoff - market support would indicate connections expect him ready first time back

runners_data.name: Cruden
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who can adapt tactics, good recent form including course and distance second 13 days ago

runners_data.name: Personal Best

races.paceDynamic: Just An Hour will attempt to dictate from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters in the field. Gallivanted, Cruden and Tryfan are likely to track prominently but none are natural early leaders, allowing Just An Hour to control the tempo through steady fractions. The large field of hold-up horses including Anniversary, Mr Freedom, Alfred Boucher, Personal Best and Individualiste will be forced to come from off the pace down the Salisbury straight. This sustainable gallop with minimal early pressure creates ideal conditions for front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace without expending energy in early battles.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Just An Hour gets an easy lead with moderate fractions
scenarios.body: Just An Hour faces no early pressure and kicks clear in the straight while the hold-up brigade struggle to bridge the gap from too far back. The front-runner's 9lb weight advantage becomes decisive when controlling his own destiny.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong through the middle sections
scenarios.body: Gallivanted or Cruden capitalize on their prominent positions to strike from close range as Just An Hour weakens late. Their superior recent form and class edge tells when positioned to pounce.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace completely collapses into a crawl
scenarios.body: The backmarkers get their preferred scenario with a sprint finish from the back, allowing Anniversary or Personal Best to unleash their turn of foot. The weight-for-age horses exploit the tactical advantage of a muddling race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Just An Hour early creating a messy pace
scenarios.body: Early speed duels compromise all the pace-setters and create opportunities for the most patient hold-up performers. Long-absent runners like Alfred Boucher or Mr Freedom benefit from the chaotic early fractions.

watchPoints.text: Just An Hour breaks cleanly and dictates uncontested fractions - becomes very difficult to peg back if controlling the tempo
Gallivanted's early positioning in the first two furlongs will determine if he can capitalize on his excellent recent form
Mr Freedom's fitness levels after 628 days off despite his excellent Salisbury record of 2 wins from 8 starts
Personal Best's sharpness returning from 197-day break given his hold-up style requires immediate fitness
The overall pace development through the middle sections on Salisbury's testing uphill finish

races.paceDynamic: Pierian will take the field along as the sole confirmed front runner, likely accompanied by fellow prominent runners Blue Noon and Liveinthelight in the early stages. With no genuine speed merchants in this field, the pace will be steady rather than demanding, allowing the front group to dictate terms without pressure. The majority of this field are hold-up horses (Alma Latina, Take A View, Sullom Voe, Palomezcal, Counter Intuitive) who will need the race to develop, but the lack of early pace may leave them with too much to do. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those who can track the pace, as they'll avoid the traffic problems that will inevitably affect the large group of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pierian Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Pierian gets an uncontested lead and dictates a steady tempo throughout
scenarios.body: The pace-setter can kick clear turning for home before the hold-up horses get organized, with fellow prominent runners best placed to respond. The large group of hold-up horses get caught flat-footed by the lack of early pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Noon and Liveinthelight press Pierian early, creating stronger pace
scenarios.body: The increased tempo sets up the race for the higher-rated hold-up horses who can close late. Alma Latina and Take A View benefit most from the honest gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lightly Raced Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the unknown quantities Krystyna, Aukus or Persian Flaw shows significant improvement
scenarios.body: Their fresh condition and potential untapped ability allows them to outclass this modest field. The betting market hasn't fully assessed their capabilities.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Muddle
scenarios.trigger: If all the prominent runners go too slowly in the early stages, creating a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge with traffic problems galore, favoring those with the best positions and strongest finishes. Hold-up horses with pace issues get swamped.

watchPoints.text: Watch for traffic problems in the straight as seven hold-up horses will all need room at once

Watch Alma Latina's position turning for home as she needs clear running to show her best

runners_data.name: Zhang Fei
runners_data.note: Front-running veteran whose uncontested lead role gives him tactical control, though modest recent RPR figures suggest vulnerability late.

runners_data.name: Fair Dinkum
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent trip credentials (1W3P similar going) but poor trainer strike-rate creates doubt about readiness.

runners_data.name: Kotari
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with clear class edge on figures but 203-day absence and stable's poor form create significant fitness concerns.

runners_data.name: Shaffron

races.paceDynamic: Zhang Fei will take them along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting what should be a sustainable gallop without early pressure from the prominent runners Market House and Fair Dinkum. The three hold-up horses - Kotari, Shaffron, and Stage Show - will rely on Zhang Fei maintaining a solid tempo to set up their late charges. With limited early pace and a small field, this becomes a tactical affair where positioning will be crucial. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can track Zhang Fei without using energy, then kick when the hold-up horses are still making ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Zhang Fei sets moderate fractions and the prominent pair get perfect trips
scenarios.body: Market House and Fair Dinkum can position ideally behind the leader and have first run on the field before the hold-up horses can mount their challenges. Their tactical advantage of being on the pace without the workload becomes decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong and Zhang Fei compounds with the prominent runners
scenarios.body: Kotari's class (RPR 84, TS 81) and David Egan's tactical nous allows him to benefit from a truly-run race where his finishing kick can overhaul tiring pace runners. The sustained gallop plays to his hold-up style perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Zhang Fei Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Zhang Fei gets soft fractions and kicks clear before the field can respond
scenarios.body: The veteran leader exploits his uncontested position to build an unassailable advantage, with his recent fourth at this trip showing he retains enough stamina. The hold-up horses find themselves with too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Zhang Fei goes very slowly and creates a sprint finish from the two-furlong pole
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test where any of the six can win, but Stage Show's long absence (684 days) becomes less relevant in a tactical affair. Class and recent form become secondary to who gets the best run.

watchPoints.text: Zhang Fei's early fractions will determine the entire complexion - if he goes too slowly, it becomes anybody's race
Kotari needs to show early signs of wellbeing given his long absence and stable's woeful recent form figures
Market House's position tracking Zhang Fei through the first half-mile will reveal tactical intentions
Fair Dinkum must overcome Jeremy Scott's concerning 0/4 recent strike-rate despite the horse's solid form
Stage Show's behaviour in preliminaries crucial given the 684-day gap since his last appearance

races.paceDynamic: Wadirumm will lead uncontested from the gates with the next nearest pace-setters being Dusk Damsel, Fullstop, Creciente and Runamara settling prominent but off the lead. This creates a controlled, sustainable gallop over 6f at Salisbury with no early pressure on the leader. The large field of hold-up horses (Apex Star, Prancy Peer, Stole My Heart, Maid In Devon, Pink Diamond Girl, Stock Market, Follow My Heart, Frankali, Sun Path) will be bunched behind waiting to pounce. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and kick when it quickens, as they avoid traffic problems while getting first run on the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses get first run on the field turning for home
scenarios.body: Dusk Damsel, Fullstop, Creciente and Runamara will have ideal positioning to strike when Wadirumm begins to tire, getting crucial momentum before the hold-up horses can organise their challenges. The large pack of hold-up runners creates inevitable traffic problems in the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops Late
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up brigade gets clear running in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Apex Star or Prancy Peer could time their run perfectly to catch the prominent horses who've done the donkey work chasing Wadirumm. The sustainable pace will leave something in the tank for a strong finisher with the right split.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Wadirumm maintains his gallop to the line under no early pressure
scenarios.body: The uncontested lead gives him every chance to see out the 6f trip, especially with Hollie Doyle's tactical awareness keeping something in reserve. The chasing pack may leave their moves too late on ground that's playing fair.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates significant traffic problems for the fancied runners
scenarios.body: Rogue Rebellion from his light weight or one of the Millman runners could benefit from cleaner passage while others get shuffled back. The bunched nature of this field makes positioning crucial in a sprint finish.

watchPoints.text: Wadirumm breaking quickly to establish uncontested lead as any early pressure could compromise his stamina reserves
Traffic problems developing in the final 2f with nine hold-up horses needing room simultaneously in a large field
Apex Star and Prancy Peer getting clear runs from their positions as both need everything to fall right
Dusk Damsel and Fullstop positioning prominently early as they could benefit most from the tactical setup
Stock Market and Follow My Heart both fading in the final furlong as both have shown this tendency recently
